purpose: Record the second controlled semantic promotion batch from the September 2026 PulseLive capability industrialisation programme.
promotion_rule: Promote only fields with complete decade-wide numeric observation, non-negative values, sufficiently direct Opta concept support, and zero-violation empirical subset checks where a parent/child relationship is asserted. Sparse/no-zero source fields remain held until blank-versus-zero semantics are governed.

empirical_results.note: Supporting consistency evidence only; the promotion relies primarily on the direct Opta Ball Recovery definition and complete numeric source coverage.

explicitly_held_fields.blockedPass: Direct semantic support exists, but 7,595/7,600 nonblank observations with no observed zeros require sparse-zero/blank semantics before reusable exposure.
explicitly_held_fields.touchesInOppBox: The 7,598-row touchesInOppBox<=touches check has zero violations, but two blanks and no observed zeros require sparse-zero/blank semantics before reusable exposure.
explicitly_held_fields.goalKicks: Direct concept support exists, but 7,579/7,600 nonblank observations with no observed zeros require sparse-zero/blank semantics before reusable exposure.
explicitly_held_fields.lostCorners: 7,440/7,600 nonblank observations with no observed zeros require sparse-zero review; the proposed opponent-corner equality could not be tested because the packaged representation supplied no comparable paired observations in the V2 audit.
explicitly_held_fields.finalThirdEntries: Complete numeric coverage, but exact entry semantics remain insufficiently defined for this batch.
explicitly_held_fields.penAreaEntries: Complete numeric coverage, but the proposed penAreaEntries<=finalThirdEntries nesting hypothesis produced 35 violations and is explicitly rejected as a semantic assumption.

falsified_assumption.interpretation: Penalty-area entries and final-third entries cannot be treated as simple nested counts on the evidence observed. This does not prove either field is invalid; it blocks that proposed relationship as a governance shortcut.

governance_note: Exposure means reusable source-native FRL research access at team_match grain. It does not imply GUI exposure, approval of derived rates, current-season 2026/27 availability, or semantic equivalence to differently named provider fields.
